forum.title: STM32N6 Unable to run VENC parallel to DCMIPP
forum.content_text:
Hi all,

I merged the VENC\_JPEG\_Encoding example with a DCMIPP app. Both parts work on their own, but the JPEG encoding breaks (error -9 = JPEGENC\_HW\_BUS\_ERROR) as soon as I turn on the DCMIPP capture. The JPEG input/output buffer is completely unrelated to the DCMIPP buffer. It’s just that as soon as I start the DCMIPP in CONTINUOUS mode, the JPEG encoder breaks… Very strange.

Did anyone else experience this problem? What could cause this? How would I fix this?

Best regards, rphii
